_note: Photo library for the Daily Brief video. source: "ours" (taken by the editor) or "stock" (licensed, shows a 'Stock image' label). use: "generic" may illustrate any story on the topic; "specific" only a story about that exact place or event. needsOriginal: the file is a 300x300 thumbnail; replace it with the full-size original (at least 2400 px wide) before it is used on screen. All files are converted to WebP with metadata (including GPS) stripped.
